t: You're looking at the monument to Sir Hans Sloane, in the churchyard of All Saints in Kensington and Chelsea. It was made by Michael Rysbrack, a Flemish sculptor who spent most of his career in England. In the first half of the eighteenth century he was one of the foremost makers of monuments, architectural decorations and portraits here. His style combined Flemish Baroque with Classical influences, and his busy workshop left an important mark on English sculpture.
